title: ophelia nervosa
intro: Ophelia nervosa, commonly known as Ophelia or Nervosa, is a plant species within the family Apocynaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of Ophelia nervosa include iridoid glycosides, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as sedative, anxiolytic, and antimicrobial properties. These constituents may contribute to the plant's traditional use in promoting relaxation and improving sleep quality.
